policy: All entries are required playable campaign work, not codex-only substitutes. Inclusion does not assert historicity.

sources.supports: Inclusion and desired dramatization only. No independent corroboration.

sources.consulted: Early Life and opening Life’s Work sections, 2026-09-28
sources.supports: Broad youth, Sodhran, regency and naming context; not all dramatic details.
A reproduced account of Sodhran, Hashmat, swimming and 20,000 practice rounds. Underlying cited works not directly consulted.
Maan Singh is spared and recruited by a ruler already at Lahore. Contradicts teenage execution version.

sources.consulted: Early career through Lahore, and Jhang/Kasur discussion, 2026-09-28
sources.supports: General chronology and a 1797 Ramnagar episode; does not establish the supplied age-15 Chatha version.

variant_groups.rule: Mutually exclusive tellings, with separate temporal frames. Do not kill and recruit the same actor.
Victory-message naming is requested lore. References instead connect renaming with the father’s victory. No automatic stable-ID or public-name migration.
Management changes, murder allegations and motives are distinct claims. No default omniscient guilt.

chronology_notes: Requested ages are not verified release dates. The active home cell remains its declared compressed 1792 frame.
The supplied Jhang/Kasur night encounters remain youth adaptations, not backdated later conquests.
Shah Muhammad remains a retrospective narrator; these original scenes are not quotations from him.

stories.title: The Bhangi Bazaar Brawl
stories.player_actions: Walk with two friends into a challenge; guard, counter and get everyone out.
stories.completion: Return together, then give the household your account.
stories.fallout: Local trouble, remembered conduct and household concern.

stories.title: The Hunt at Ladewali / Hashmat Khan
stories.player_actions: Track quarry, become separated, survive the mounted ambush and fight back.
stories.completion: Resolve the encounter and physically rejoin the party.
stories.fallout: Injury, witnesses and rival-household repercussions.

stories.title: The Child at Sodhran
stories.player_actions: Keep a camp supplied as Mahan falls ill; scout and command against relief forces.
stories.completion: Complete the siege episode inside the fixed Mahan endpoint.
stories.fallout: Command experience and inherited obligations, not an alternate survival timeline.

stories.title: The Throne of Lahore: Pardon
stories.player_actions: Travel incognito, duel Maan Singh, bring him alive to Lahore and reveal identity.
stories.completion: Conclude with pardon and an offer of service.
stories.fallout: A former adversary can become an ally.

stories.title: Out of the Regents’ Sight
stories.player_actions: Slip out of household supervision and meet companions without a remote alert.
stories.completion: Return or face the household response after witnesses report.
stories.fallout: Attendance, household suspicion and personal independence.

stories.title: The Inherited Ammunition
stories.player_actions: Obtain access to ammunition, practise with friends and account for spent stock.
stories.completion: Finish a bounded shooting outing with its actual supply cost.
stories.fallout: Skill practice competes with household military reserves.

stories.title: Across the River
stories.player_actions: Read the bank and current, swim or ride a crossing and stay with companions.
stories.completion: Reach the far bank and recover the whole party.
stories.fallout: Route familiarity, fatigue and remembered assistance.

stories.title: Taking the Reins
stories.player_actions: Hear conflicting accounts, secure support and assume administration.
stories.completion: Complete an explicit authority transfer without omniscient motives.
stories.fallout: New obligations and changed household relationships.

stories.title: The Great Boar Hunt
stories.player_actions: Track a boar, manage a frightened horse and evade or meet its charge.
stories.completion: Resolve the hunt and return with the party.
stories.fallout: Horsemanship, injury and the story companions tell.

stories.title: A Night in the Nihang Camp
stories.player_actions: Enter a dera without royal ceremony, join its kitchen work, listen and train.
stories.completion: Earn situated hospitality and leave with what was actually heard.
stories.fallout: Personal ties rather than automatic command over a community.

stories.title: Nights in the Bazaar
stories.player_actions: Attend a celebration, choose company, wagers or drinking and interpret talk.
stories.completion: Return from the gathering with attributed, fallible accounts.
stories.fallout: Expense, fatigue, friendships and exposure; no magical truth drink.

stories.title: Against the Afghan Advance
stories.player_actions: Scout movements, protect villages and disrupt a military supply route.
stories.completion: Withdraw or return after a bounded raid with the actual party.
stories.fallout: Supplies, witnesses, retaliation and regional alliances.

stories.title: A Pouch for the Playground
stories.player_actions: Choose whom to share personal coins with, play together and reciprocate help.
stories.completion: Complete a shared outing without buying guaranteed obedience.
stories.fallout: Specific friendships, obligations and an actual purse debit.

stories.title: The Falcon in Another Courtyard
stories.player_actions: Follow a missing bird, enter a rival court and confront its keeper.
stories.completion: Recover the falcon by the selected negotiation or standoff.
stories.fallout: A local grievance, witnesses and custody of the animal.

stories.title: The Unwritten King
stories.player_actions: Evade or attend lessons, hear accounts aloud and reconstruct a discrepancy.
stories.completion: Give an oral answer based on received information.
stories.fallout: Memory and trust without instantly granting literacy or infallibility.

stories.title: The Day Budh Singh Became Ranjit
stories.player_actions: Play the victory-message and father-son naming tradition as a declared variant.
stories.completion: Conclude the retrospective without renaming the stable actor key.
stories.fallout: Viewer story experience; preserve the existing public-name convention.

stories.title: Budha Singh and Desi
stories.player_actions: Hear the ancestral horse story, then play its crossing and a later riding challenge.
stories.completion: Finish each perspective with separate inventory and memories.
stories.fallout: Inherited aspiration, not a proven causal diagnosis of character.

stories.title: The Fighting at Jhang
stories.player_actions: Reconnoitre approaches, manage ammunition and fight or withdraw in close quarters.
stories.completion: Return with surviving companions and conserved supply records.
stories.fallout: Local retaliation and logistics, not free territory.

stories.title: The Village Alarm
stories.player_actions: Hear a local alarm, gather companions and intercept a livestock or crop raid.
stories.completion: Recover the party and resolve the disputed goods.
stories.fallout: Protection obligations, losses and witness accounts.

stories.title: Keys to the Household
stories.player_actions: Investigate a court threat, choose allies and contest access to administration.
stories.completion: Resolve the selected palace-conspiracy adaptation.
stories.fallout: Authority and persistent antagonism; accusations remain attributed.

stories.title: The King of Thieves: Lethal Variant
stories.player_actions: Use a small retinue as bait and duel the bandit leader on the road.
stories.completion: Resolve the requested lethal ending and survivors’ surrender.
stories.fallout: A distinct adaptation, never the same history as the pardon ending.

stories.title: Night Encounter near Kasur
stories.player_actions: Follow a raid through rain and navigate a low-visibility interception.
stories.completion: Extract the party or force the raiders back.
stories.fallout: Visibility, wet equipment, wounds and disputed accounts.

stories.title: Raj Kaur: Conflicting Accounts
stories.player_actions: Play the requested dark household story through an explicitly chosen telling.
stories.completion: Resolve that telling without converting allegations into universal facts.
stories.fallout: Family rupture and conflicting testimony; no automatic guilt revelation.

stories.title: The Clash at Ramnagar
stories.player_actions: Read an approaching charge, hold formation or break into the clash.
stories.completion: Rally and physically extract the party.
stories.fallout: Command costs and recognition; identities/date remain versioned.

stories.title: The Battle of the Brick Kilns
stories.player_actions: Locate pinned companions, draw attention and manoeuvre around kiln walls.
stories.completion: Recover them or break the opposing position.
stories.fallout: Local losses, attention and a remembered risk.

stories.title: The Hounds in the Courtyard
stories.player_actions: Respond to an insult, command the hounds and choose when to recall them.
stories.completion: End the confrontation with all actors’ condition retained.
stories.fallout: Fear, grievance and household reaction, not a free obedience bonus.

stories.title: The Unrecognized Heir
stories.player_actions: Enter incognito, join a dice dispute, face the watch and navigate detention.
stories.completion: Resolve recognition, release and the response to the watchmen.
stories.fallout: Disguise can fail locally; knowledge travels through witnesses.

stories.title: The Sialkot Tribute Raid
stories.player_actions: Scout a collection post, muster a finite party and carry captured goods home.
stories.completion: Extract, settle custody and face a rival’s response.
stories.fallout: Grain, money, casualties and retaliation remain conserved.
